He poured his tea, sat, and began to write.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一台尚未重启的机器。路灯仍亮着，把湿漉漉的马路照成一条条金色的河。环卫工人扫过落叶，声音清脆如钟摆。便利店的灯独自明亮，玻璃上映出偶尔驶过的出租车。写字楼里零星几扇窗还亮着，像失眠的眼睛。天空泛出蟹壳青，早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽。整座城市在梦与醒之间，安静地翻了个身。", "w03": "• A recursive story is one that tells a smaller copy of itself inside itself, again and again.\n• To solve a big problem, you do one small piece, then hand the rest to a copy of yourself that does exactly the same trick.\n• When the problem becomes so tiny you can answer it instantly, that answer travels back up the chain, and the whole big problem gets solved."}
